correctness.rationale: In characteristic two the polar alternating 4-by-4 Pfaffian detects geometric smoothness. Independently enumerated all 64 alternating forms (28 nondegenerate), all 448 smooth quadrics and all 56 fully Pfaffian-nondegenerate polar planes, each with 256 square-term lifts: total 14336. An independently constructed GL4(F2) action yielded exactly five orbits of sizes 336,560,3360,5040,5040, with all claimed 15-point base incidences. Direct independent Groebner unit-ideal tests on all four affine charts for each representative found only (192,357) and (192,358) have geometrically smooth base, giving 10080. Hasse forbids smooth genus-one intersections with zero or six rational points. Small finite exhaustive census is complete because all 1024 forms and all group orbits were covered.
